title: Exchange an MCP authorization code for tokens
content_data:
Use this endpoint to exchange your authorization code for an access token and a refresh token. You bind this token request directly to the MCP server path specified in the URL. # Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/{server}/oauth/token/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | Content-Type {Required} | string | Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. | ``` **Path parameters** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |server {Required}|string|The specific TikTok for Business MCP server URL.

Enum values: `tt-ads-mcp-flat`, `tt-ads-mcp-layer`.

To learn more about how these server URLs differ, see [Choose your server URL](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/how-to-connect-a-custom-agent-to-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3#anchor-3).| ``` **Body parameters** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |grant_type {Required}|string|The method for granting tokens.

Enum value:
  • `authorization_code`: To exchange an authorization code for an access token.
| |code {Required}|string|The authorization code that was issued to you after the user approved the authorization.| |code_verifier {Required}|string|PKCE verifier corresponding to the original code challenge.

The original, unhashed random string used to generate your `code_challenge` during the [initial authorization request](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/request-user-authorization/v1.3). The server will hash this verifier using SHA-256 and compare it to your original code challenge. If they match, the server verifies your application's identity and will issue the access token.| |redirect_uri {Required}|string|The redirect URI for validation.

Ensure it exactly matches the redirect URI you used in the [initial authorization request](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/request-user-authorization/v1.3).| ``` ## Example > **Note**
> The example below uses `tt-ads-mcp-layer` as the `{server}` value. You can replace this with your chosen server value. ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer/oauth/token' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \ --data-urlencode 'grant_type=authorization_code' \ --data-urlencode 'code={{code}}' \ --data-urlencode 'code_verifier={{code_verifier}}' \ --data-urlencode 'redirect_uri={{redirect_uri}}' (/code) ``` # Response A successful exchange returns HTTP `200 OK`. ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |access_token|string|The access token issued to you.| |refresh_token|string|The refresh token issued to you for future token renewals.| |token_type|string|The type of token issued.

Enum value:
  • `bearer`: Bearer token, an OAuth 2.0 access token where possession of the token itself is sufficient for access.
| |expires_in|integer|The remaining validity period of the access token, expressed in seconds.| |refresh_token_expires_in|integer|The remaining validity period of the refresh token, expressed in seconds.| |scope|string|The specific permission scope granted to your token.

Enum value:
  • `mcp:tt4b`: the necessary permissions to access TikTok for Business MCP server features.
| ``` ## Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "access_token": "{{access_token}}", "expires_in": 86399, "refresh_token": "{{refresh_token}}", "refresh_token_expires_in": 2591999, "scope": "mcp:tt4b", "token_type": "bearer" } (/code) ``` ## Error response A failure returns HTTP `400 Bad Request`. ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | error | string | Error code.
To learn about the possible errors and descriptions, see [List of possible errors](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/exchange-an-mcp-authorization-code-for-tokens/v1.3#anchor-2-2-1). | | error_description | string | The human-readable description of the error.
To learn about the possible errors and descriptions, see [List of possible errors](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/exchange-an-mcp-authorization-code-for-tokens/v1.3#anchor-2-2-1). | ``` ### List of possible errors ```xtable |error{50%}|error_description{50%}| |---|---| |`invalid_request`|`grant_type is required`| |`invalid_request`|`code is required`| |`invalid_request`|`code_verifier is required`| |`invalid_request`|`redirect_uri is required`| |`unsupported_grant_type`|`grant_type is not supported`| |`invalid_grant`|`authorization code not found or expired`| |`invalid_grant`|`redirect_uri does not match authorization request`| |`invalid_grant`|`code_verifier does not match code_challenge`| |`invalid_grant`|`token is bound to a different MCP server`| ```
